newsitem.title: USA: Novoste gets FDA OK to begin trial.
newsitem.headline: Novoste gets FDA OK to begin trial.

text.p: Novoste Corp said Thursday it received an Investigational Device Exemption from the U.S. Food and Drug Administration to perform a placebo-controlled multi-center trial of its Beta-Cath System.
The company said the purpose of the trial is to support a premarket approval application in the United States.

Novoste said that to the best of its knowledge, it's the first company to receive FDA approval to conduct such a trial of an intracoronary beta radiation therapy device for the reduction of restenosis.
The multicenter study, the "Beta-Cath System Trial," is expected to begin within a few weeks and is designed to include about 1,100 patients at 27 medical centers.
Each of the patients will be evaluated eight months after being treated with the Beta-Cath System to determine therapuetic success.

Novoste develops intracoronary radiation therapy devices for the treatment of restenosis. Restenosis, a renarrowing of a previously treated artery, is the principal limitation of coronary angioplasty.
